messages.subject: Re: map import
parts:
On Thu, 15 Sep 2005 10:34:17 -0700, Shana Rapoport wrote:

> >Hello. I am new to Distance and am having difficulty importing a GIS map.
> >I have the shapefile but do not have any ESRI software to do the necessary
> >editing for the import to Distance. Does anyone know of a program that will
> >enable me to open and edit the shapefile?

> >Thank you,
> >Shana

In case anyone else is interested in this, below is the reply I sent to Shana
last week. Also, I've just added the ability in Distance to cut and paste the
coordinates of a shape to and from text and spreadsheet files - which should
make it easier for those without a GIS to import geographic data into
Distance. This facility will be in the next release of Distance.

- Len

-------------------------------------------------------------------
From: "Distance Development" <dist...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk>
To: "Shana Rapoport" <sbrap...@hotmail.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Sep 2005 17:28:28 +0100

Hi Shana,

I Googled around a bit, and came up with
http://www.digitalgrove.net/fgis.htm
which might work for you. I haven't tried it, so please let me (and the list)
know if it works. If it doesn't work, let me know and I'll Google round a bit
more -- or perhaps you can try the same approach! Whatever you find out, I'd
be very grateful if you could post a summary of your findings to the list, to
help future people who have a similar question. Thanks!

- Len Thomas
